reader.requirement: At --std 85 an OPEN I-O of a relative file that cannot support the I-O-mode input and output operations is unsuccessful with status 37 (VIII.1.3.4 4)c.2), and a successful OPEN I-O places the file in an open mode in which every Table 2 I-O-column statement of its access mode (sequential READ/REWRITE/START/DELETE; random and dynamic READ/WRITE/REWRITE/DELETE, dynamic START) is permitted, while statements outside that column (a sequential-access WRITE) are not.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility via FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect: at 85 no Table 19 arbitration (no 61) and sibling buffered records released before the OPEN body
default sharing mode: AllOther at 85, ReadOnly/NoOther by mode from 2002
host share-mode refusal maps to 30 at 85, 61 from 2002
refuses the 2002 SHARING phrase on OPEN at 85 (COBOL0900)

reader.edition-search: grep of Runtime/IO for SharingFacilityInEffect|DialectBehavior|Edition and of SequentialIoBinder.BindOpen (edition-agnostic; the gate is VersionConformancePass). The 37 write-capability check itself (PermitsWrite in OpenOnceEntered) consults no edition and is the same arm at every edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for this rule's 37 and I-O-mode permissions; the sharing arbitration that rides the same OPEN path differs (no 61 at 85), which this rule does not govern
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f19_03 exercises a successful OPEN I-O in dynamic access only (WRITE, random READ, REWRITE); the 37 refusal, sequential and random access I-O, START and DELETE are not exercised

reader.notes: The write-capability question is asked once above the organizations (FileConnector.OpenOnceEntered via HostFile.PermitsWrite) for every non-INPUT OPEN of a present file, so a read-only relative file answers 37 at 85 exactly as at 2023; the relative store adoption reads through a ReadWrite handle in I-O mode. The 1985 I-O column of Table 2 is enforced at run time (48 for a sequential WRITE).
